newsitem.title: FINLAND: FOREST INDUSTRY'S MAY RAW WOOD PURCHASES UP - METLA.
newsitem.headline: FOREST INDUSTRY'S MAY RAW WOOD PURCHASES UP - METLA.

text.p: The forest industry's purchases of raw wood from private forests rose in May to 3.2 million cubic metres, up by 0.4 million cubic metres on April, the Finnish Forest Research Institute (METLA) said on Monday.
In the past five years, average purchases in May have been 2.3 million cubic metres, it said in a statement.
In January-May, the industry's purchases from private forests increased 20 percent year-on-year to 12.2 million cubic metres, METLA said.

Logwood prices rose further in May, and prices were 14-16 percent up year-on-year, METLA said. Pulpwood prices were largely unchanged in May compared to previous months, but the prices were 15-21 percent higher than in May last year.
METLA said the price rises had increased trade in raw wood.
